episode_title: An Attitude of Gratitude with Natasha Lee, CEO and Co-Founder of Floyd Lee Locums

real_qa.q: What is Floyd Lee Locums' business model and how does the company operate in the healthcare staffing industry?
real_qa.r: Floyd Lee Locums is a healthcare staffing company that places doctors in hospitals across the country where they are critically needed, allowing the company to show up every day and make healthcare a little bit better. The company focuses on positioning physicians in ways that play to their career growth while helping facilities gain ultimate flexibility in coverage.
real_qa.requete: Floyd Lee Locums business model healthcare staffing

real_qa.q: How did Floyd Lee Locums grow from its 2017 founding to $45 million in revenue by 2024?
real_qa.r: Floyd Lee Locums landed around $45 million in revenue in 2024, seven years after its founding in 2017. The company built an entire brand from scratch and achieved this growth by identifying a gap in the marketplace for a different kind of locums company that positioned physicians creatively around their career needs and facility flexibility requirements.

real_qa.q: What awards has Floyd Lee Locums won for being a best place to work?
real_qa.r: Floyd Lee Locums won SIA Best Place to Work for five years in a row and four out of five years overall. The company also won Modern Healthcare's number one supplier award across the country for two years in a row, recognizing that employees love doing the work and see it as an opportunity to impact patients and healthcare daily.
real_qa.requete: Floyd Lee Locums SIA Best Place to Work awards

real_qa.q: How did Floyd Lee Locums solve a critical healthcare access issue in rural North Carolina through locum tenens staffing?
real_qa.r: Floyd Lee Locums placed an oncologist seeking flexibility in the Outer Banks area of North Carolina with an arrangement of one week in person, two weeks via telehealth, and one week off. This creative scheduling allowed him to help build an oncology program for a four-county rural area where patients previously had to drive three hours to receive oncology care.
real_qa.requete: Floyd Lee Locums oncologist Outer Banks North Carolina rural

real_qa.q: What percentage of Floyd Lee Locums' senior and executive leadership team is female?
real_qa.r: Female representation on Floyd Lee Locums' senior and executive leadership team is 30%, which the company is proud of and plans to continue prioritizing through intentional hiring and development of women into larger leadership roles.
real_qa.requete: Floyd Lee Locums female executive leadership percentage

guest.bio_context: Natasha Lee began her staffing career unexpectedly after being hired as a straight commission outside salesperson at a commercial staffing company in Atlanta, where she achieved top sales performance in her first year. She later joined Matt Floyd at Trinity Healthcare as Chief Operating Officer and grew the company from $20 million to $90 million in revenue over approximately four and a half years. In 2017, she co-founded Floyd Lee Locums with Matt Floyd to address a gap in the locum tenens market by offering physicians greater flexibility and positioning them to serve rural healthcare communities.

real_quote: Every day I choose to do this work with an attitude of gratitude, because we can always look at the challenges and the problems, but when we focus on the things that we're getting right, it's just a powerful thing.
